title: Targeting senescence-associated fibrotic signatures identifies syringin as an effective modulator of the ATR/CHK1-p53 axis in idiopathic pulmonary fibrosis.
authors: Wang, Yuyang; Yin, Guanghui; Niu, Mixing; Wang, Wei; Liao, Zhenyun; Yang, Lei; Wu, Chunli; Cao, Yu; Gao, Kai; Dong, Zhaoxing
one_liner_zh: 该文研究IPF中衰老相关纤维化及syringin调节ATR/CHK1-p53轴，涉及分子对接但非蛋白质-DNA互作，与本课题无关。
abstract: Idiopathic pulmonary fibrosis (IPF) is a progressive and fatal interstitial lung disease closely associated with aging, yet the contribution of cellular senescence to fibrotic remodeling and its therapeutic implications remain incompletely understood. Syringin, a phenylpropanoid glycoside derived from Acanthopanax senticosus, has been reported to possess anti-inflammatory and antioxidant activities, but its role in IPF has not been elucidated. In this study, bulk lung transcriptomic data from the GTEx project and nine IPF cohorts were integrated with IPF scRNA-seq data to characterize senescence-associated fibrotic programs. A systems-level compound prioritization strategy incorporating reversed gene expression scoring, network proximity analysis, drug-likeness and toxicity evaluation was applied to identify candidate molecules. The results revealed a pronounced aging-associated transcriptomic profile in IPF lungs, with strong concordance between age-related and IPF-related gene programs. Single-cell analyses further identified senescent fibroblast populations as key cellular hubs characterized by elevated expression of SASP factors. Syringin was subsequently validated in TGFbeta1-stimulated fibroblasts, and a murine model of bleomycin-induced pulmonary fibrosis. Syringin consistently attenuated fibroblast activation, cellular senescence markers, and pulmonary fibrosis in vivo and in vitro. Mechanistically, syringin markedly reversed the activation of replication stress-associated signaling pathways. Molecular docking and CETSA suggested a potential interaction between syringin and CHK1. Furthermore, CHK1 knockdown partially abrogated the regulatory effects of syringin on the ATR/CHK1-p53 signaling cascade, supporting CHK1 as a functional mediator of syringin activity. Collectively, these findings identify syringin as a natural small molecule with anti-senescent and anti-fibrotic properties, and may represent a potential therapeutic strategy for IPF.
abstract_zh: 特发性肺纤维化（IPF）是一种与衰老密切相关的进行性致命间质性肺病，然而细胞衰老对纤维化重塑的贡献及其治疗意义仍未完全阐明。丁香苷（Syringin）是一种源自刺五加（Acanthopanax senticosus）的苯丙素苷，据报道具有抗炎和抗氧化活性，但其在IPF中的作用尚未被揭示。本研究整合了来自GTEx项目和九个IPF队列的肺组织批量转录组数据以及IPF scRNA-seq数据，以表征衰老相关的纤维化程序。采用一种系统层面的化合物优先排序策略，结合反向基因表达评分、网络邻近性分析、药物相似性和毒性评估，以识别候选分子。结果显示，IPF肺中呈现出显著的衰老相关转录组特征，年龄相关与IPF相关基因程序之间具有高度一致性。单细胞分析进一步将衰老成纤维细胞群体识别为关键细胞枢纽，其特征是SASP因子表达升高。随后，在TGFbeta1刺激的成纤维细胞和博来霉素诱导的肺纤维化小鼠模型中验证了丁香苷的作用。丁香苷在体内和体外均持续减弱成纤维细胞活化、细胞衰老标志物及肺纤维化。机制上，丁香苷显著逆转了复制应激相关信号通路的激活。分子对接和CETSA提示丁香苷与CHK1之间存在潜在相互作用。此外，CHK1敲低部分消除了丁香苷对ATR/CHK1-p53信号级联的调节作用，支持CHK1作为丁香苷活性的功能介导因子。综合这些发现，丁香苷被鉴定为一种具有抗衰老和抗纤维化特性的天然小分子，可能代表IPF的一种潜在治疗策略。
